name: City of Angles
description: Los Angeles, 1947. The war is over, but the shadows are just beginning.
seed_prompt: A hard-boiled noir setting of private eyes, femme fatales, and corruption that reaches the highest offices.
lore_content:
Los Angeles gleams under the California sun, but the city's heart is rotten. The studios control everything, the mob controls the studios, and nobody controls the dark impulses of the powerful.

Sam Marlowe runs a one-man detective agency out of a third-floor walkup on Wilshire. Ex-cop, ex-drunk, currently trying to stay both. He takes the cases the police won't touch - usually because touching them gets you killed.

Lilith Crane is the most dangerous woman in Hollywood. A former actress now married to studio head Victor Crane, she runs the Avalon Club, where the elite conduct business too dirty for boardrooms. She's hired Marlowe twice. Both times, people died.

Detective Rosa Valdez is one of three women on the LAPD and the only one who works homicides. The brass wants her to fail; the boys' club wants her gone. She solves cases anyway, usually the ones her colleagues are paid to bury.

Johnny Marcone owns the waterfront. The Marcone family ran booze during Prohibition and guns during the war. Now they're branching into legitimate business - which means buying politicians and breaking anyone who won't sell.

Victor Crane controls Olympus Pictures and half the scandals in Hollywood. Starlets who cross him disappear. Stars who expose him have accidents. He keeps files on everyone, insurance against a world that might someday turn on him.

Lorelei Lake was the biggest star in Hollywood until the scandal. Now she lives in a Malibu estate, drinking herself to death. She claims she's writing her memoirs. The studio claims they'll destroy her if she publishes. Someone hired Marlowe to find out which way she'll jump.

Down in Central Avenue, the jazz clubs keep playing despite the segregation, despite the raids. Singer Ella Divine knows secrets she's never told anyone. She watched a movie star commit murder ten years ago. Now that star is running for Congress, and Ella has started receiving threats.
